summation.displayName: MyD88 binds to IRAK (IL-1 receptor-associated kinase) and th...
summation.text: MyD88 binds to IRAK (IL-1 receptor-associated kinase) and the receptor heterocomplex (the signaling complex) and thereby mediates the association of IRAK with the receptor.  MyD88 therefore couples a serine/threonine protein kinase to the receptor complex.
